title: Underwriting Limits and Funding Window — Kestrel Advantage Balloon Tiers
content:
Every tier of the Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract carries five underwriting figures: an advance limit measured against the vehicle's value basis, a payment-to-income limit, a minimum down payment, a dealer funding window and a cap on the customer's combined Kestrel consumer exposure.

## Schedule

| | Tier 5 | Tier 4 | Tier 3 | Tier 2 | Tier 1 | Tier 1+ |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Maximum advance, percent of vehicle value basis | 100 | 105 | 110 | 115 | 120 | 125 |
| Maximum scheduled payment, percent of verified gross monthly income | 12 | 13 | 14 | 15 | 16 | 18 |
| Minimum cash or trade equity down payment, percent of selling price | 15 | 10 | 10 | 5 | 0 | 0 |
| Funding window, calendar days after the contract date | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Relationship exposure cap, USD (including the new contract) | 45000.00 | 60000.00 | 85000.00 | 110000.00 | 150000.00 | 200000.00 |

## What each figure measures

| Figure | Measured against |
|---|---|
| Maximum advance | The vehicle value basis: MSRP for a new vehicle, wholesale book value for a pre-owned vehicle |
| Maximum scheduled payment | Verified gross monthly income |
| Minimum down payment | The selling price; cash or trade equity both count |
| Funding window | Calendar days after the contract date within which the dealer must deliver a complete contract package to be funded |
| Relationship exposure cap | The customer's maximum combined Kestrel consumer exposure, including the new contract |

## Notes on the schedule

- A minimum down payment of 0 for Tier 1 and Tier 1+ means no down payment is required on those tiers.
- The funding window is 30 calendar days on every tier.
- *Hypothetical illustration:* on a Tier 4 contract with a selling price of USD 30000.00, the minimum down payment is 10 percent of the selling price, USD 3000.00.
